summary: First E2E test of Atho MVP. Backend: 35/36 pytest cases passed (97.2%). Auth (email register/login/me/google-rejection), onboarding, profile patch, exercises (170 seeded - barbell category returns 35, bench search works, custom create works), full workout flow (start→active→finish with PR detection via Epley 1RM and total_volume=1100 verified), exercise history & lifetime_volume, calendar by month, feed/explore, like/save/comments, user search, follow public→accepted & private→pending, notifications + unread-count + mark-read, conversations & messages, analytics overview & per-exercise (1RM points, plateau, imbalance), insights premium-gating (402 for non-premium, 200 with LLM/rule fallback after DB premium flip), subscription status & cancel. ONLY FAILURE: /api/subscription/checkout returns 500 because STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent' is a placeholder and Stripe rejects it as 'Invalid API Key provided'. Frontend: login → onboarding → tabs render correctly, Analytics/Subscription/Settings/Calendar/Add-Exercise/Active-Workout screens all load with correct testIDs, seeded exercises visible, subscribe button visible on subscription page.

critical.issue: Returns 500 'Failed to create checkout'. Backend logs show Stripe rejects key: error_message='Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent'. The env value STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent' in /app/backend/.env is a placeholder, not a real Stripe test key. Either set a real sk_test_... key OR migrate to emergentintegrations payments helper (which uses Emergent's managed Stripe). Reference: /app/backend/server.py:32-35, 1417-1430; /app/backend/.env

minor.issue: Backend log warning: 'LlmChat object has no attribute with_max_tokens'. The LLM call at /app/backend/server.py:1357 chains .with_max_tokens(1024) which is not a valid method on emergentintegrations LlmChat — the call raises and falls back to rule-based insights so the endpoint still returns 200, but AI-powered output never reaches users. Replace .with_max_tokens(...) with a supported config or drop it.
passlib bcrypt warning at startup: 'module bcrypt has no attribute __about__'. Cosmetic only — hashing still works. Pin bcrypt<4 or upgrade passlib if you want to silence it.

integration_issues.issue: Subscribe button will hit /api/subscription/checkout which currently returns 500 (see backend critical). The 'Try Premium' button on /analytics and 'Subscribe' on /subscription will fail until Stripe key is fixed.

issues: Console warnings: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' — web-only deprecation warnings from React Native Web. Functional impact: none on web preview, but should be cleaned up. shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius used in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (still valid on native iOS/Android — only web complains).

action_items: FIX Stripe checkout: replace placeholder STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent' with a real Stripe test key OR migrate /api/subscription/checkout (server.py:1410-1445) to use emergentintegrations payments helper.
FIX LLM insights: remove the invalid .with_max_tokens(1024) chain on LlmChat in server.py:1357 (it crashes the AI path and silently falls back to rules).
Optional: clean up React Native Web deprecation warnings (Image style.resizeMode → props.resizeMode; shadow* → boxShadow when web).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is large (~1600 lines) — consider splitting into routers (auth/workouts/feed/social/payments/analytics) when next iterating.
STRIPE_API_KEY has empty-string default (os.environ.get('STRIPE_API_KEY','')) — fine, but the current .env value is a non-functional placeholder.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (note: not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — confirmed via /app/frontend/.env. All API calls resolved correctly during testing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (all targeted testIDs rendered: login-screen, onboarding-screen, feed-screen, analytics-screen, subscription-screen, settings-screen, calendar-screen, add-exercise-screen, active-workout-screen)

rca_of_issue: Stripe checkout 500: stripe.Customer.create() is called at server.py:1417 using stripe.api_key set from env STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent'. Stripe API responds 401 invalid_request_error ('Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent') because this is a non-existent placeholder key, not a real sk_test_... Stripe test key. Reproduction: register a user, POST /api/subscription/checkout with Bearer token → 500 'Failed to create checkout'. Mitigation: (a) replace .env STRIPE_API_KEY with a real Stripe test secret key OR (b) refactor /api/subscription/checkout & /api/subscription/webhook to use Emergent's emergentintegrations stripe payments wrapper (which transparently routes via Emergent's managed Stripe and accepts the Emergent-provided key).
